abstract: The concentration of magnesium in serum has been shown to fall to potentially dangerously low levels after several courses of treatment with cis-diamminedichloroplatinum II (cis-platin). The aims of this study were to examine the effects of magnesium supplementation on predicted outcome of treatment, rate of response to treatment and toxicity of treatment. Sixteen patients with testicular cancer were studied in detail over a 14 month period. One patient with an ovarian dysgerminoma was also included in the study. Eight patients were randomised to receive magnesium supplements both intravenous and oral; nine did not. The non-supplemented group showed significantly greater renal tubular damage as assessed by urine N-acetyl-B-D-glucosaminidase (NAG). There was a trend towards a reduction in treatment delays due to neutropenic episodes in the supplemented group, and serum magnesium concentrations remained significantly higher. Neither group showed differences in tumour growth rates or outcome. These results show that magnesium supplements are of considerable benefit and show no harmful effects in patients receiving cis-platin treatment. It is is suggested that magnesium supplements should be a routine part of the treatment regime, and that these should comprise both i.v. supplements during treatment and oral supplements between courses.
abstract_ja: シスプラチン（cis-platin）の投与を数コース受けた後、血清マグネシウム濃度が危険なほど低値に低下することが知られている。本研究の目的は、マグネシウム補充が治療の予後予測、治療反応率、毒性に及ぼす影響を検討することであった。精巣がん患者16例を14か月間詳細に追跡した。1例は卵巣未分化胚細胞腫の患者も含まれた。8例は静脈内および経口のマグネシウム補充を受けるよう無作為に割り付けられ、9例は補充を受けなかった。補充を受けなかった群では、尿中N-アセチル-β-D-グルコサミニダーゼ（NAG）で評価した腎尿細管障害が有意に大きかった。好中球減少症に伴う治療遅延は補充群で減少傾向を示した。血清マグネシウム濃度は補充群で有意に高く維持された。両群間で腫瘍増殖速度や転帰に差は認められなかった。これらの結果は、シスプラチン治療を受ける患者にとってマグネシウム補充が大きな利益をもたらし、有害作用を示さないことを示している。マグネシウム補充は治療計画の定型的な一部とすべきであり、治療中の静脈内補充とコース間の経口補充の両方を含むべきであると考えられる。
